Defines the core data structures and utility functions for parsing Fedora repository metadata, module information, and RPM package names used in OVAL dictionary ingestion.

## Key Components

| Type / Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `repoMd` / `repo` / `location` | XML-mapped structs for parsing `repomd.xml` repository metadata |
| `bugzillaXML` | XML/JSON struct for Bugzilla bug data (blocked list and alias) |
| `moduleInfo` | YAML-mapped struct representing a single entry from `modules.yaml`, including name, stream, version, context, arch, and artifact RPMs |
| `moduleInfosPerVersion` / `moduleInfosPerPackage` | Nested map types indexing `moduleInfo` by OS version and package name |
| `Rpm` | Typed string representing a raw RPM filename from module artifacts |
| `ConvertToUpdateInfoTitle()` | Formats a `moduleInfo` into a human-readable update info title (`name-stream-version.context`) |
| `ConvertToModularityLabel()` | Formats a `moduleInfo` into a modularity label string (`name:stream:version:context`) |
| `NewPackageFromRpm()` | Parses an RPM filename string into a `models.Package` struct, extracting name, epoch, version, release, and arch |
| `uniquePackages()` | Deduplicates a `[]models.Package` slice by `Filename` |
| `mergeUpdates()` | Merges two `map[string]*models.Updates` maps, appending update lists for matching OS versions |

## Usage Example

```go
// Parse an RPM filename into a Package struct
rpm := Rpm("bash-5.1.8-6.el9.x86_64.rpm")
pkg, err := rpm.NewPackageFromRpm()
if err != nil {
    log.Fatal(err)
}
// pkg.Name == "bash", pkg.Version == "5.1.8", pkg.Arch == "x86_64"

// Generate modularity label from moduleInfo
info := moduleInfo{}
info.Data.Name = "nodejs"
info.Data.Stream = "18"
info.Data.Version = 20230101
info.Data.Context = "abcdef01"

label := info.ConvertToModularityLabel()
// label == "nodejs:18:20230101:abcdef01"

title := info.ConvertToUpdateInfoTitle()
// title == "nodejs-18-20230101.abcdef01"
```
